content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lexington

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Verify you meet the credential's prerequisites—typically a secondary diploma plus years of documented project leadership, or a bachelor's degree plus relevant experience. Granite PM Academy's advisors can review your background at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. You'll engage with experienced instructors and peer cohorts in real time, covering the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and practical applications. Most Lexington professionals complete this requirement over 4–6 weeks while managing work schedules.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the contact-hour requirement, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education and experience. Pay the exam fee and official application fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and application procedures to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, including practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your PMP exam through Pearson VUE at a local testing center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult concepts in the weeks leading up to test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, maintain your PMP by earning professional development units over each three-year renewal cycle. Lexington professionals meet this requirement through courses, conferences, volunteer project work, and self-study. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education options to support your ongoing credentialing and career growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
